concerns.location: tasks.md:T003 vs spec.md:FR-002, Edge Cases ('Non-stationary Sampling'), SC-004
concerns.text: T003 asserts synced.csv has "zero NaNs", but FR-002 permits interpolation only for gaps ≤6h and the spec's edge case says extreme gaps (>6h) "trigger a warning and are excluded from correlation calculations". No task defines how >6h gaps are represented in synced.csv or excluded from correlations, so the no-NaN assertion is unsatisfiable on real 23-year ACE data with long outages. Add a task/clause specifying >6h gap handling (e.g., NaN rows excluded downstream) and reconcile the no-NaN check.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T004, T006 vs spec.md:FR-004, FR-010, SC-003; constitution.md:Principle VII
concerns.text: T004/T006 implement Holm-Bonferroni + MTM-EDF, replacing the spec-mandated Bonferroni (FR-004, SC-003) and Pyper & Peterman lag-1 Neff (FR-010). The plan documents this as a "Spec Defect Resolution", but the spec was never amended and constitution Principle VII NON-negotiably requires "Bonferroni correction ... exactly as outlined". Tasks inheriting an un-amended spec/constitution contradiction preserve the drift; the spec/constitution must be formally updated or the tasks must implement the mandated method.

concerns.location: tasks.md (all tasks) vs spec.md:Assumptions ('diagnosed via variance-inflation factors')
concerns.text: The spec assumes collinearity "will be diagnosed via variance-inflation factors", but no task computes or records VIF diagnostics; T009 only mentions the collinearity caveat descriptively in prose. The promised diagnostic is silently dropped — add a VIF computation/recording step or explicitly de-scope it in the spec.

SC-004 requires the data-acquisition/sync pipeline to complete within 30 minutes using ≤4 GB RAM. T005 benchmarks only the correlation run (SC-001); no task measures or verifies the SC-004 sync runtime/memory budget. Add SC-004 measurement to T003's verification.
